Class ImportExportDocumentsFlowControllerTest

@IsTest()
private class ImportExportDocumentsFlowControllerTest

Unit tests for ImportExportDocumentsFlowController. Validates the invocable method routing and the import/export operations for menu items and customizations against mocked Firestore endpoints.

Group:
    Test Classes

Since:
    04/11/2021

Version:

  • 04/19/2021 - v1.1 - Tests for exportCustomizations() and importCustomizations()

  • 09/11/2021 - v1.3 - TestData.setSettingsForRequests() no longer used
